formulas.name: Force of Mortality
formulas.conditions: S differentiable and positive at x.
formulas.whenToUse: Given S(x) explicitly, find the instantaneous mortality rate.
formulas.commonMistake: Dropping the negative sign, giving a negative (nonsensical) force of mortality.

formulas.name: Annuity-Immediate Present Value
formulas.symbols: v=1/(1+i): the discount factor; n: number of payments.
formulas.conditions: Level payments of 1 at the end of each period.
formulas.commonMistake: Using this formula when payments actually start immediately (annuity-due case).

formulas.name: Deferred Annuity Value
formulas.conditions: Applies to either immediate or due versions.
formulas.whenToUse: Valuing an annuity that starts m periods from now.
formulas.commonMistake: Forgetting the extra v^m discount factor for the waiting period.
